The '''Goshyn Detention Center''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]<ref name="Gamer3" /> located in the [[Goshyn system/Legends|Goshyn system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Tolonda sector/Legends|Tolonda sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] before<ref name="Gamer4">{{GamerCite|4|Ships of the Smuggler's Alliance}}</ref> [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{GamerCite|3|The Smugglers Alliance}} establishes that [[Billey]] had been released from the Goshyn Detention Center by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].</ref> the asteroid served as a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="Gamer3" />

Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], when the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Billey]] was gravely injured as a result of a confrontation with an [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], he was arrested and delivered to the Goshyn Detention Center. Billey regained consciousness in the asteroid's [[Doctor/Legends|medical]] ward,<ref name="Gamer3" /> where the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] judged that the only way to heal the smuggler was to implant a new, [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Bone/Legends|spine]] and [[Lung/Legends|lung]] system. Billey refused and grew increasingly frail while he served out his [[Prisoner/Legends|term]] at the prison.<ref name="Thrawn">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> However, only Billey's body was broken when he was finally released from the Goshyn Detention Center. With his mind intact, he soon resumed his smuggling operations.<ref name="Gamer3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Goshyn Detention Center was introduced in ''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'', a [[1994]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook authored by [[Eric S. Trautmann|Eric Trautmann]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TLSS">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Goshyn [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the asteroid, in grid square Q-18.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
